about: miDataworks behaviour-dataset journey step table (backend/src/services/behaviour/journey.py JOURNEY), read by AST at the commit named; pinned by tests/cross_repo/test_dw_journey_live.py (R3 review fix OR3-int-3, 2026-11-16).

steps.title: Read the behaviour's definition
steps.done_when: a version or a detector set records the definition

steps.title: Save the behaviour's rule set (its rule signals)
steps.done_when: a rule set carries the key

steps.title: Save the generation templates
steps.done_when: a generation template carries the key

steps.title: Save the recipes (the carrier plan and the build)
Build the carrier plan version
steps.done_when: a version built from one of the behaviour's recipes

steps.title: Generate carriers, one run per generator
steps.done_when: a generation run with the key completed

steps.title: Build the labelled version (insertion, renderings, labels, value-directed split)
steps.done_when: two versions built from the behaviour's recipes (the plan and the build)

steps.title: Score a stratified sample with a second opinion
steps.done_when: a label run with the key completed

steps.title: Read the agreement by stratum
steps.done_when: a label run with the key completed (the agreement is read from it)

steps.title: Send the disagreements to review
steps.done_when: a review queue carries the key

steps.title: Create the detector sets (main and one per sub-question)
steps.done_when: a detector set carries the key

steps.title: Check the sets
steps.done_when: a send of the behaviour's sets records its checks

steps.title: Send the sets to miWorkbench
steps.done_when: a send of the behaviour's sets completed
